decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 4 - No work shall be carried out until detailed sections of the single storey rear extension and construction information have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The details so approved shall be carried out as part of the development.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, erection of roof extension on 2nd and 3rd floor incorporating internal alteration to house.
